<style id="sicesi-mpc-inline-css">
.sicesi-featured-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}
.sicesi-featured-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
.sicesi-featured-credit-text{font-style:italic}
.g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
.entry-featured-media .g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-credit-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .wp-caption-text{display:none!important}

/* --- Masquer TOUT crédit sur la home (Elementor ou pas) --- */
body.home .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figure.sicesi-featured-figure > figcaption,
body.home figure.sicesi-inline-figure > figcaption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figcaption[aria-label="Crédit image"] {
	display: none !important;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full, figure.wp-block-image.size-large {
	position: relative;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full figcaption.sicesi-image-caption, figure.wp-block-image.size-large figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {
	position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    color: white;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px 8px;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption {	
	background: none;
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {	
	text-align: right;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption {	
	text-align: left;
	background: none;
	    background: linear-gradient(0deg, #000000b3, #0000004d 70%, #0000);
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption em {	
	max-width: 70%;
	display: block;
}
.sicesi-inline-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}.sicesi-image-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
/*# sourceURL=sicesi-mpc-inline-css */
</style>

    (function() {
        window.plausible = window.plausible || function() { 
            (window.plausible.q = window.plausible.q || []).push(arguments) 
        };
        
        // Type de navigation
        var navEntry = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0];
        var navType = navEntry ? navEntry.type : 'unknown';
        
        // Analyser le referrer
        var referrer = document.referrer;
        var referrerType = 'direct';
        
        if (referrer) {
            if (referrer.indexOf('sciencepost.fr') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'internal';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('google') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'google';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('facebook') > -1 || referrer.indexOf('fb.com') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'facebook';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('t.co') > -1 || referrer.indexOf('twitter') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'twitter';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('discover') > -1 || referrer.indexOf('googleapis') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'discover';
            } else {
                referrerType = 'external';
            }
        }
        
        // Landing page ou navigation interne
        var isLanding = !sessionStorage.getItem('sp_visited');
        sessionStorage.setItem('sp_visited', '1');
        
        // Préchargement
        var isPrerender = document.visibilityState === 'prerender';
        
        // Source WonderPush
        var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        var isFromPush = urlParams.has('utm_source') && 
                         urlParams.get('utm_source').toLowerCase().indexOf('push') > -1;
        
        // Extraire le domaine du referrer
        var referrerDomain = 'direct';
        if (referrer) {
            try {
                referrerDomain = new URL(referrer).hostname;
            } catch(e) {
                referrerDomain = 'invalid';
            }
        }
        
        // Envoyer à Plausible
        plausible('Homepage Visit', {
            props: {
                nav_type: navType,
                referrer_type: referrerType,
                is_landing: isLanding ? 'yes' : 'no',
                is_prerender: isPrerender ? 'yes' : 'no',
                is_from_push: isFromPush ? 'yes' : 'no',
                referrer_domain: referrerDomain
            }
        });
        
    })();

<style id="sicesi-mpc-inline-css">
.sicesi-featured-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}
.sicesi-featured-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
.sicesi-featured-credit-text{font-style:italic}
.g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
.entry-featured-media .g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-credit-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .wp-caption-text{display:none!important}

/* --- Masquer TOUT crédit sur la home (Elementor ou pas) --- */
body.home .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figure.sicesi-featured-figure > figcaption,
body.home figure.sicesi-inline-figure > figcaption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figcaption[aria-label="Crédit image"] {
	display: none !important;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full, figure.wp-block-image.size-large {
	position: relative;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full figcaption.sicesi-image-caption, figure.wp-block-image.size-large figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {
	position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    color: white;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px 8px;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption {	
	background: none;
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {	
	text-align: right;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption {	
	text-align: left;
	background: none;
	    background: linear-gradient(0deg, #000000b3, #0000004d 70%, #0000);
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption em {	
	max-width: 70%;
	display: block;
}
.sicesi-inline-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}.sicesi-image-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
/*# sourceURL=sicesi-mpc-inline-css */
</style>

.g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
.entry-featured-media .g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}

body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .entry-media-credit,

body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .wp-caption-text{display:none!important}

/* --- Masquer TOUT crédit sur la home (Elementor ou pas) --- */
body.home .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figure.sicesi-featured-figure > figcaption,
body.home figure.sicesi-inline-figure > figcaption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figcaption[aria-label="Crédit image"] {
	display: none !important;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full, figure.wp-block-image.size-large {
	position: relative;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full figcaption.sicesi-image-caption, figure.wp-block-image.size-large figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {
	position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    color: white;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px 8px;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption {	
	background: none;
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {	
	text-align: right;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption {	
	text-align: left;
	background: none;
	    background: linear-gradient(0deg, #000000b3, #0000004d 70%, #0000);
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption em {	
	max-width: 70%;
	display: block;
}
.sicesi-inline-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}.sicesi-image-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}

        // Analyser le referrer
        var referrer = document.referrer;
        var referrerType = 'direct';
        
        if (referrer) {
            if (referrer.indexOf('sciencepost.fr') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'internal';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('google') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'google';
            } else if (referrer.indexOf('facebook') > -1 || referrer.indexOf('fb.com') > -1) {
                referrerType = 'facebook';

                referrerType = 'twitter';

                referrerType = 'discover';
            } else {
                referrerType = 'external';
            }
        }
        
        // Landing page ou navigation interne
        var isLanding = !sessionStorage.getItem('sp_visited');
        sessionStorage.setItem('sp_visited', '1');
        
        // Préchargement

        var isFromPush = urlParams.has('utm_source') && 
                         urlParams.get('utm_source').toLowerCase().indexOf('push') > -1;
        
        // Extraire le domaine du referrer
        var referrerDomain = 'direct';
        if (referrer) {
            try {
                referrerDomain = new URL(referrer).hostname;
            } catch(e) {
                referrerDomain = 'invalid';
            }
        }
        
        // Envoyer à Plausible
        plausible('Homepage Visit', {
            props: {
                nav_type: navType,
                referrer_type: referrerType,
                is_landing: isLanding ? 'yes' : 'no',

                is_from_push: isFromPush ? 'yes' : 'no',
                referrer_domain: referrerDomain

<style id="sicesi-mpc-inline-css">
.sicesi-featured-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}
.sicesi-featured-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
.sicesi-featured-credit-text{font-style:italic}
.g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
.entry-featured-media .g1-frame{background-color: transparent !important}
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) .sicesi-featured-credit-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .entry-media-credit,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) + .wp-caption-text,
body.single-post .entry-featured-media:not(.entry-featured-media-main) ~ .wp-caption-text{display:none!important}

/* --- Masquer TOUT crédit sur la home (Elementor ou pas) --- */
body.home .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figure.sicesi-featured-figure > figcaption,
body.home figure.sicesi-inline-figure > figcaption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-featured-caption,
body.home .elementor .sicesi-image-caption,
body.home figcaption[aria-label="Crédit image"] {
	display: none !important;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full, figure.wp-block-image.size-large {
	position: relative;
}

figure.wp-block-image.size-full figcaption.sicesi-image-caption, figure.wp-block-image.size-large figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {
	position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    color: white;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px 8px;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption {	
	background: none;
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.sicesi-image-caption {	
	text-align: right;
    font-size: 9px;
	font-weight: normal;
    opacity: 0.8;
	color: #ababab;
	/* text-shadow: -2px -1px 4px #000, 2px -1px 4px #000, -2px 2px 4px #000, 2px 2px 4px #000; */
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption {	
	text-align: left;
	background: none;
	    background: linear-gradient(0deg, #000000b3, #0000004d 70%, #0000);
}

.wp-block-gallery.has-nested-images figure.wp-block-image figcaption.wp-element-caption em {	
	max-width: 70%;
	display: block;
}
.sicesi-inline-figure{display:inline-block;margin:0}.sicesi-image-caption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:0 1rem;font-size:0.9rem;line-height:1.4;color:#666;margin-top:0.35rem;}
/*# sourceURL=sicesi-mpc-inline-css */
</style>
